title: Wave quantities (তরঙ্গ-সংশ্লিষ্ট রাশি)
placement: Book page 195, section 7.2.3 তরঙ্গ-সংশ্লিষ্ট রাশি: next to the definitions of তরঙ্গদৈর্ঘ্য and তরঙ্গের বেগ and the formula v = fλ (with the উদাহরণ of চিত্র ৭.০৮ on page 197: a = 0.1 m, λ = 1 m, T = 0.2 s, f = 5 Hz, v = 5 m/s).
description: The quantities of a wave (তরঙ্গ-সংশ্লিষ্ট রাশি, pages 195–197, 7.2.3) on a real rope. On a teak lab bench a mechanical wave driver (powder-coated body, speaker grille, chrome drive shaft, brass clamp) fed by a signal generator (its display shows f) shakes one end of a 3 m braided rope; the far end runs through two foam pads that soak up the wave, over a pulley to a slotted mass. Behind the rope a graph board is the metre scale (0–3 m in tenths, ±0.1 m, the rest line). The rope's surface is y = a cos(kx − ωt), rebuilt every frame. It opens still, like the book's চিত্র ৭.০৮ in 3D: λ (orange, crest to crest), a (green) and a marked particle (green bead). The one action 'এক দোলনকাল চালাও' (or a tap on the driver) runs time for exactly one period T, slowed ten times: the driver goes once up and down, the bead once round, a crimson clock counts t to T, and a blue arrow follows the first crest, which ends exactly one λ on, where a faint copy of the start shape shows the wave looks the same again: v = λ/T = fλ. The row of words: 5 Hz (the book's 7.08: λ = 1 m, v = 5 m/s), 10 Hz (λ = 0.5 m), 2.5 Hz (λ = 2 m) on the same rope (v stays 5 m/s), and a heavy rope at 5 Hz (v = 2.5 m/s, λ = 0.5 m: the medium changes v and λ, never f). The panel draws the বিচ্যুতি–দূরত্ব and বিচ্যুতি–সময় graphs live (λ, a, T marked), the result v = f × λ and the book's rule as it grows. Test: five tap questions read a, λ, the phase of points A–E (চিত্র ৭.০৯), v from the generator's f and the scale's λ, and what doubling f does. Phone-first, Bangla.
